note: Whole-pool inputs for the pool composition defaults. Every figure describes the whole pool or every profile submitted; none comes from invited candidates.

pool.source: IRCC Express Entry Year-End Report 2024, Table 17a: candidates in the pool who qualify for CBS criteria, as of Dec 1, 2024

poolByProgram.source: IRCC Express Entry pool by program and NOC, 2025 snapshot, as compiled by Maple Immigration Chronicles (Express Entry 2025: NOC Analytics). Secondary compilation; the four programs add up to the stated total.

largestPoolOccupations.source: Same 2025 pool snapshot: the most common primary occupations in the pool

profiles2024.source: IRCC Express Entry Year-End Report 2024, Table 3 (eligible profiles by additional point type) and fact sheet (category shares of eligible profiles)

categoryOccupations.source: IRCC Express Entry Year-End Report 2024, Annex: category-based selection occupations (NOC 2021)

singleOccupationDraws.source: IRCC rounds of invitations: eligibility for the Senior managers and Physicians rounds (Canadian work experience in these occupations is required)

expressEntryEligibleOccupations.source: Statistics Canada NOC 2021 Version 1.0: unit groups in TEER 0 (48), 1 (97), 2 (162) and 3 (69)
